Install and locate the 3D-CMCC-FEM executable

Source: R/model_exe.R
install_model.Rd

The model executable is not shipped with the package. install_model downloads it (or copies a local file) in a user directory, once; model_path returns the executable that will be used by run_3DCMCCFEM and model_available tells whether one is available.

Usage

install_model(source = .model_url(), dir = .model_dir(), overwrite = FALSE)

model_path()

model_available()

Arguments

source

Character: URL or path of a local file of the executable. Default to the Windows build of the version 5.7 published in the GitHub releases of R3DFEM. On Linux and macOS the model must be compiled from the source code and the path of the binary given here (or with the option below).

dir

Character: directory where the executable is installed. Default to tools::R_user_dir("R3DFEM", "data") (option R3DFEM.model_dir).

overwrite

Logical: overwrite an executable already installed? Default to FALSE

Value

install_model: invisibly, the path of the installed executable. model_path: the path of the executable (error if not found). model_available: TRUE or FALSE.

Details

The executable used by the package is searched, in order, in:

  1. the option R3DFEM.exe, e.g. options(R3DFEM.exe = "C:/models/3D_CMCC_Forest_Model_5.7.exe");

  2. the environment variable R3DFEM_EXE;

  3. the executable installed by install_model in dir.

Examples

model_available()
#> [1] FALSE
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
install_model()
# or use an executable already on disk
install_model("C:/models/3D_CMCC_Forest_Model_5.7.exe")
model_path()
} # }
